result.instructions: Tools for GoSweetSpot, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which carriers and services can I book for this site, and what do they cost to New Zealand addresses?"; "Show me all pending orders from today and create ones that are missing from the queue."; "Where is consignment WRR1406658 now, and when was it delivered?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GoSweetSpot data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gosweetspot_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gosweetspot_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gosweetspot_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. gosweetspot_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gosweetspot_list_services
tools.title: List carriers and services
tools.description: List the carriers and services this API key can book, with account numbers. Good first call before creating shipments or rates. GoSweetSpot API: GET /api/availableservices.

tools.name: gosweetspot_list_stock_sizes
tools.title: List stock sizes
tools.description: List the package stock sizes set up for this site, with their dimensions. Use a stock size name in gosweetspot_get_rates. GoSweetSpot API: GET /api/stocksizes.

tools.name: gosweetspot_list_printers
tools.title: List printers
tools.description: List the printers available to this user, with label type and online status. GoSweetSpot API: GET /api/printers.

tools.name: gosweetspot_list_customer_orders
tools.title: List customer orders
tools.description: List customer orders published to the GoSweetSpot queue, with optional filters by packing slip number, created date range and completion. GoSweetSpot API: GET /api/customerorders.

includeProducts.description: True adds the product lines to each order.

tools.name: gosweetspot_list_pending_orders
tools.title: List pending orders
tools.description: List orders that were published but not yet processed (no shipment ticket). GoSweetSpot API: GET /v2/pendingorders.

tools.name: gosweetspot_get_order_status
tools.title: Get order status
tools.description: Get the current status of one order by its packing slip number: PENDING, PICKED or DELIVERED, with ticket number and tracking URL. GoSweetSpot API: GET /v2/order/{packingslipno}.

packingslipno.description: The order's packing slip number (your order reference).

tools.name: gosweetspot_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments with their status and last update, filtered by consignment numbers, order numbers or a last-update window. If consignments or order numbers are given, the window is ignored. GoSweetSpot API: GET /api/shipments.

tools.name: gosweetspot_get_shipment_status
tools.title: Get shipment status
tools.description: Get the current status, pickup and delivery times, tracking URL and line events for up to the consignment numbers given. GoSweetSpot API: POST /v2/shipmentstatus.

tools.name: gosweetspot_get_rates
tools.title: Get shipping rates
tools.description: Get the courier services and prices for one destination and its packages, without creating a shipment. Returns available rates with QuoteId, plus rejected rates and validation errors. GoSweetSpot API: POST /api/rates.

CountryCode.description: ISO alpha-2 country code, e.g. NZ, AU.

Name.description: Stock size name from gosweetspot_list_stock_sizes, or "custom".

Type.description: Box, Carton, Satchel, Bag, Pallet, etc.

HasDG.description: True if the package holds dangerous goods.

tools.name: gosweetspot_validate_address
tools.title: Validate an address
tools.description: Check one address for state, suburb, postcode and country. For NZ it also flags rural, Saturday and residential delivery, and lists the services that reach it. GoSweetSpot API: POST /v2/addressvalidation.

CountryCode.description: ISO alpha-2 country code, e.g. NZ, AU.

tools.name: gosweetspot_save_customer_orders
tools.title: Save customer orders
tools.description: Create orders in GoSweetSpot or update pending ones, in one batch. An order whose packing slip number was already processed is ignored. Does not book any carrier. GoSweetSpot API: PUT /api/customerorders.

packingslipno.description: Your unique order number (packing slip number).

city.description: City, or state code where the country has states.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code, e.g. NZ, AU.

isSignatureRequired.description: True for signature on delivery; false for authority to leave.

unitkg.description: Weight of one unit in kg.

orders.description: Orders to create or update, max 100 per call.

tools.name: gosweetspot_delete_shipments
tools.title: Delete unprocessed shipments
tools.description: Delete consignments that are not yet picked up, in one call (max 50). Returns the outcome per consignment, e.g. Deleted, or the reason it could not be deleted (already in transit, delivered or manifested). GoSweetSpot API: DELETE /api/shipments.

consignmentNumbers.description: Consignment numbers to delete, max 50, one per item.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with GoSweetSpot
prompts.description: What you can do with GoSweetSpot here, with example requests to try.
